_comment: TC-039: the requests the analyze-lab-report Edge Function makes (service role) for one lab report. Pinned on both sides: supabase/functions/_shared/analyzeLabReport_test.ts proves the handler sends exactly these requests (real supabase-js on a fake fetch), and tests/integration/analyze-lab-report.test.ts proves the real migrated schema + storage accept them. Only the report id comes from the webhook payload; everything else is re-read from the row's real columns. {report_id} is the lab_reports id, {patient_id} its patient_id, {pdf_path} its stored object path. The update merges the analysis into the existing `data` payload and adds exactly the keys in analysis_update.data_keys_added.
